title: StockReservationExpired
description: Reply (ADR 0006). Published by inventory-service through its outbox (aggregateType=StockReservation, key=orderId). Consumed by order-service, which deduplicates this event by eventId (it has no command and is never re-published). Emitted by inventory's expiry job, not by a command: these lines passed their TTL while RESERVED and were freed. An order may receive several, each covering some of its lines (one per inventory transaction).

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).
